proposals.evidence: Full CDIAL aṅguli subsection 2 aṅgūḍi explicitly gives Gawri aṅguṛṛik, Kalasha aṅgūṛyak, Bshk áṅgīr, Torwali äṅgī and Kandia hagūī/Maiyan agui. The selected Dardic āŋgū/āŋīr/æŋgī/hāŋgvī forms and complete Gawri/Bshk slash responses follow this specific branch. Source rhotic loss, aspiration, v/w-like glide, vowels and spacing remain unchanged and qualified; longer Gawri -ik is directly represented in the full article. Local IA transmission remains unresolved, without collapsing the two dictionary branches. Exact response: hāŋgvī.
